pages.title: Delight Add-ons
pages.text: A family of small mods adds foods that all use the Farmer's Delight pot, board and skillet. The rules are the same everywhere: bring ingredients, a heat source and the right container. Look recipes up in JEI (hover, press **R**). Meals and crops are listed below.

pages.title: Extended
pages.text: Farmer's Delight: Extended adds dishes made only from existing Minecraft, Create and Farmer's Delight items. No new crops or mobs. Cheese, burgers, breakfast plates, ice cream.

pages.title: Fruits Delight
pages.text: Fruit trees and bushes (pear, kiwi, mango, persimmon, lychee, fig and more) with jams, pies, jellos, popsicles and drinks.

pages.title: Fungi Delight
pages.text: Mushroom cooking: morel, inky cap and truffle crops and dishes such as truffle pasta and morel soup. Morel cows also exist.

pages.title: My Nether's Delight
pages.text: Hoglin, ghast and Nether-plant dishes, plus Nether-flavoured cabinets and decor. Meant for cooking in the Nether. Bastion chests hold some of its extras, like strider eggs.

pages.title: Ocean's Delight
pages.text: Food from sea creatures: fugu, guardian parts, tentacles and more. Cook it carefully, as fugu is poisonous raw.

**Berries and Cherries Delight** adds grapes, strawberries, cherries, jams and pies.\
\
**Aquaculture Delight** lets Aquaculture fish work in Farmer's Delight recipes.
**Sniffers Sniff Delights** makes Sniffers dig up tomato, cabbage, rice and onion seeds far more often.

**Delightful Creators** is the Create bridge: soups as fluids, sequenced assembly meals and a Mechanical Cutter. See [#](2E5AAC)[Kitchen Automation](entry://food/kitchen_automation)[#]().\
\
**Brewin' and Chewin'** adds kegs and fermented drinks: [#](2E5AAC)[Brewing](entry://food/brewing)[#]().\
\
Base mechanics: [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]().
